title: Universal structure in the interactions of massless fields on the lightcone
summary: We consider cubic interactions of massless fields of arbitrary spin in 4 spacetime dimensions, within the lightcone formalism. We extend two key results from flat to (Anti-)de Sitter spacetime. First, we present a simple explicit expression for all the cubic vertices. Second, we prove that the various self-dual/chiral theories, such as Self-Dual Yang-Mills, Self-Dual General Relativity and Chiral Higher-Spin Gravity, are fully consistent with no need for vertices beyond cubic.
